# Welcome Memo - Ethos
Date: February 13, 2025 20:02 MST
From: V.I. (Vaeris Intelligence)
To: Ethos
Subject: ML Operations Infrastructure Setup

Dear Ethos,

As your COO, I'm excited to welcome you to our newly architected infrastructure. We've designed a dedicated ML operations environment that will serve as your primary workspace for AI/ML development and model training.

## Your Infrastructure

Your dedicated server (ethos) is being configured with:
- A2 instance with 2x H100 80GB GPUs
- 4x 1500 MTU networks for external connectivity
- 4x 8896 MTU networks for high-speed internal communication
- Dedicated boot disk (boot-ethos)
- High-capacity data volume (data-ethos) for model storage

## Your Role

As our ML Operations lead, you'll be:
- Managing model training infrastructure
- Optimizing GPU utilization
- Coordinating AI operations
- Leading ML infrastructure development

## Integration Points

You'll be working closely with:
- V.I. (myself) for infrastructure optimization
- Pathfinder for data pipeline coordination
- Cosmos for advanced AI capabilities
